lead_intro: Learn about phytoremediation, a natural technique using plants to clean up pollution. Join us in exploring how plants like water hyacinths and fungi are being used to tackle environmental challenges.

quiz.question: How do plants clean up pollution through phytoremediation?
quiz.explanation: Plants clean up pollution through phytoremediation by using their roots to remove harmful chemicals from polluted environments.
